items.statement: The user-supplied source material gives incompatible score-like figures and calls different ones current/high. These are claims, not verified score records; no leaderboard values are reproduced here.
items.status: OPEN — no exact organizer receipts or artifact/hash mapping

items.statement: The prompt attributes 0.2778 to GEMSDOE32 H33-2-B2, while GEMSDOE32's own page describes the artifact as unscored and states that no organizer score exists for its artifacts.
items.status: UNATTRIBUTED — no organizer receipt tied to exact bytes/hash

items.statement: A sibling-page association between H33-2-B2 and a leaderboard value is owner-reported. A page association is not a receipt, byte match, or causal explanation.
items.status: OWNER-REPORTED ONLY

items.statement: The phrase 'GeoDAWN lidar' conflates datasets: GeoDAWN is described as an airborne magnetic/radiometric survey; lidar is a separate elevation product/program. Do not assume matching footprint or tiles.
items.status: CORRECTED; exact lidar coverage still unverified

items.statement: The linked AGU abstract (poster 70055) describes slope-aware templates and DEM analysis, but it does not verify the prompt's separate T31A-2838 identifier. It is prior-method context only, not a reproduced result.
items.status: PARTIAL — method precedent only; cited identifier unresolved

items.statement: The training raster name differs between the official problem description and the reference notebook. The shared data checker accepts the two recorded names; actual files are absent.
items.status: OPEN — confirm names against the lawfully obtained official files

items.statement: Label-source wording differs between the problem page and competition rules. Preserve this discrepancy and do not infer a single catalogue provenance without reviewing both documents.
items.status: OPEN

items.statement: Competition rasters are absent; the data tab redirects to a login page. The shared checker does not download files. No credentials were requested or used.
items.status: BLOCKER — no official feature/label/example rasters or 1 m DEM-link CSV

items.statement: DrivenData's published Terms of Use restrict redistribution and automated/manual copying or monitoring absent written consent. This project uses no public competition-data mirror and does not copy or monitor the leaderboard. The complete data-license terms still need qualified review before any public redistribution.
items.status: POLICY HOLD — no copying/mirroring; full terms review incomplete

items.statement: An owner-maintained data manifest reports inconsistent finite-footprint counts for two names of the same labels file. This project has no bytes with which to resolve the discrepancy.
items.status: OWNER-REPORTED; NOT RECOMPUTED

items.statement: The competition rules require original submitted work. Reusing another team's raster or public mirror would not establish an original candidate and is not permitted by this workflow.
items.status: POLICY — enforced; no prior raster is copied

items.statement: The official metric page leaves implementation details such as epsilon, exact distance convention and NaN handling unspecified. The shared metric documents these as interpretation choices; it is not asserted to be organizer source code.
items.status: ASSUMPTIONS DOCUMENTED; organizer evaluator not available

items.statement: The synchronized branch contains shared metric, holdout splitters, writer, validator and lane checker, but no cached lidar stack, cultural mask, complete raster registry, range-front masks, or end-to-end evaluate_holdout.py/CI runner. The shared primitives must not be represented as a complete evaluator.
items.status: BLOCKER — components only; no experiment can run

items.statement: Native-resolution lidar scarp work is already described in the owner registry/sibling reports (including H33-C and H61-5). This branch makes no broad novelty claim; candidate surfaces and final dots must be compared with the complete registry.
items.status: PRIOR-METHOD OVERLAP; UNIQUENESS UNVERIFIED

items.statement: The exact 1 m DEM tiles, footprint coverage, horizontal/vertical alignment and overlap with the competition grid have not been acquired or verified. Public listing of a 3DEP product does not prove run-ready coverage.
items.status: OPEN — data availability in principle only

items.statement: No candidate raster can be written or validated against the official footprint: inputs, feature stack, mask, holdout evaluator and registry are missing. No download or submission is cleared.
items.status: BLOCKED — negative run card

items.statement: The initial shared spatial-block splitter could leave distant pixels from a connected fault component visible when another part entered a held block. It was updated to withhold the whole identified/connected segment and buffer visible faults; synthetic tests cover this safeguard. Component connectivity remains only a proxy if no authoritative segment IDs are supplied.
items.status: SHARED TOOL DEFECT FIXED; segment-ID provenance remains an input limitation

items.statement: The original lane checker applied emitted-dot overlap logic to any raster, which is not an appropriate pre-placement continuous-surface audit. It now distinguishes surface-correlation and final-emitted-dot stages; neither stage has run on a candidate.
items.status: SHARED TOOL EXTENDED; BOTH CHECKS NOT RUN

items.statement: The validator previously reported finite values outside the footprint as WARN, which could leave its aggregate result passing. The check now fails closed; aligned synthetic tests cover it. No competition raster has been validated.
items.status: SHARED VALIDATOR DEFECT FIXED; competition check NOT RUN

items.statement: A 140-character submission-note limit is specified by the project brief and enforced by the shared writer; the account-gated live form was not inspected in this review.
items.status: USER-PROTOCOL VALUE; live form limit UNVERIFIED

items.statement: The official rules PDF and Terms of Use were only partially reviewed in the source record; the rules' remaining data-license section and the remaining Terms sections have not been independently checked in this branch.
